# Add commit_timestamp column and related index to compile_runs table

This migration adds a commit_timestamp column to the compile_runs table to differentiate between PR merges (using merged_at) and direct commits (using commit_timestamp). It also creates a composite index on repo_id and commit_timestamp for efficient querying. The downgrade function ensures reversibility by removing the index and the column if needed.
